description: Apply software engineering principles to design and implement a working system.
Collaborate effectively in an agile team using version control and sprint-based delivery.
Design and query relational databases to support application requirements.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs following industry best practices.
Communicate technical decisions clearly through written documentation and oral presentation.
Prepare and preprocess datasets for machine learning, including handling missing values, encoding categorical variables, and feature scaling.
Apply supervised machine learning algorithms to classification and regression problems.
Evaluate machine learning models using appropriate metrics, cross-validation, and analysis of overfitting and underfitting.
Improve machine learning model performance using hyperparameter tuning and feature selection.
Apply unsupervised learning and clustering techniques to identify patterns in data.
Design relational data models using entities, attributes, relationships, primary keys, and foreign keys.
Apply normalization principles to improve relational database design.
Write SQL queries using filtering, joins, grouping, subqueries, and aggregate functions.
Apply database integrity, transaction, constraint, and indexing concepts.
Transform conceptual database designs into relational schemas and implement them using a DBMS.
